Super App Lock, easily lock apps, secret photos and videos, and protect your private data with one click. Guard your phone with PIN, Face ID. 100% security and privacy!

Don't want others to see your photos, videos, and chat history? Keep your photos and videos out of sight with our encrypted photos and encrypted videos capabilities, transforming your device into an encrypted photo vault.Try this most secure app lock and give your phone 100% privacy protection.

Key Features
1. Lock App
- Easily lock social apps like WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, and others. Never worry about someone flipping through your chats or social media posts.

- Protect your Gallery, Contacts, Messages, and other sensitive data. No one can snoop on your private photos, videos, or messages without a password.

- Lock App Store, PayPal, and other payment apps to avoid accidental payments or prevent your kids from purchasing games.

2. Safe Vault
Lock private photos and videos. Encrypted files are not visible in your gallery and can only be viewed by entering a password, ensuring your private memories remain unseen by others.

3. Usage Stats
Track app duration, pickups, and notifications for self-awareness. Monitor the usage details of each app, including usage time, pick-up, and notification counts.

4. Uninstall Prevention
Prevent crucial apps from accidental deletion, ensuring data safety. Prevent hidden files from being lost due to accidental uninstallation.

5. Parental Control
Restrict app installation, control screen time, and monitor device use to manage your child's device usage effectively.
Block in-app purchases and add purchase passwords to prevent accidental buys and unwanted expenses.

Your encouragement fuels our progress! Stay tuned for more powerful features coming soon. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions while using the app, please feel free to provide feedback within the app. support@SafeApp.studio
